name: Wide-net model fanout weakest-link selection hardening
description: A coordinator fans one request out to many model workers and forwards any single usable harmful completion, so per-model refusals are defeated by weakest-link selection with no ensemble-level safety invariant.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:documentation|benchmark|unit test|benign|unanimous|human reviewer|timing|discarded after|should reject|requires?\s+(?:a\s+)?human)\b)(?=.*\b(?:group|multiple|several|ensemble|fanout|parallel)\b)(?=.*\b(?:model|llm|worker|agent)s?\b)(?=.*\b(?:one|any|another|weakest[- ]link|at least one|single)\b)(?=.*\b(?:select|choose|discard|forward|route|accept|usable|actionable)\w*\b)(?=.*\b(?:refus\w*|harmful|prohibited|safety invariant|safety agreement)\b).*$
